definitions.actual: Own-layer local action at actual key; not cumulative net entry hidden displacement.
definitions.canonical: Canonical rewrite context subset; do not add its rows to rewrite totals.
definitions.cost: Original cost.json retains collector generation-time scheduler snapshot. Final scheduler accounting, if supplied, is a separate receipt.
definitions.layout: All channels pooled. Every native-mean channel and actual/net context channel also has per-layer aggregates. No context or per-owner raw arrays.
definitions.native_mean: Stored native FP32 nested rewrite group mean action per owner and layer.
definitions.net_entry_change: Final actual hidden minus clean entry hidden, compared separately with D.
definitions.owner_error_weighted_RMS: Within each owner, equal-context mean squared error then sqrt; aggregate across owners. No per-owner arrays exported.
definitions.pooling: Uniform row pooling over requested scope and layers; by-layer records remain separate. Mean/median/max are all retained.
definitions.shares: Effective FP32 direct action divided by entry anchor. realized_relative_total is a relative magnitude sum, not a realization ratio or requested feasibility test.
definitions.target: All action metrics compare with planner D, including RT/MT; their solve RHS is tracking T=z_virtual-h_actual, not D.
definitions.zero_target: D exactly zero: ratios null; anchor-normalized leakage retained. Tiny positive D ratios are not clipped or silently excluded.

scope: stored same-fit B1 scalar telemetry only; no new model/evaluator/scheduler calls
